summary: Iteration 48: Verified month/year filter on Pengantaran page. Backend GET /api/deliveries supports year+month query params, works combined with status/archived, and defaults path (no params) still returns all. Frontend defaults to current month/year, summary line shows month name + count + total ongkir, empty state message displays when no deliveries, tabs and status buttons still integrate correctly with the month filter.
critical_code_review_comments: list_deliveries only applies the created_at filter when BOTH year AND month are provided (`if year and month`). If a client passes only year or only month it is silently ignored. Minor; UI always sends both.
server.py is now 2395 lines; consider splitting into routers (deliveries, transactions, auth, etc.) per code review guideline (>700 lines).
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_ITER48 delivery transactions created and deleted after each test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pengantaran month filter feature fully verified. Backend endpoint uses regex ^YYYY-MM on created_at. UI selects default to current (Oktober 2026 at time of test). Both filters work with tabs and archive. No regressions detected.
